screenLevelIssues.explanation: The entire 'Recent Payments' section (containing the Toggle and Transaction List) is missing from the Simulator rendering. It should be positioned between the Card Carousel and the Footer.
The Payment Card in the simulator lacks the texture/image overlay present in Figma. Figma uses a layered fill: Solid #202020 + Image (16% opacity) + Solid #000000 (64% opacity).
The pagination dots (Frame 2095586316) below the card carousel are missing in the simulator.
The 'Review & pay' button in the footer lacks the specific gradient stroke and shadow effects defined in Figma (Frame 2095586312).

feedback.explanation: The 'Recent Payments' section (containing Toggle and Transaction List) is missing from the render. Structural analysis confirms the existence of transaction rows (Paid, Pending, Failed) with specific layout data.
Button 'Rectangle 140' has a fill mismatch. Structural analysis requires #4D4D4D.
Payment Card background is missing texture. Figma uses Solid #202020 + Image (16% opacity).
feedback.fixedCode:
<ImageBackground 
  source={require('@/assets/card-texture.png')} 
  style={{ backgroundColor: colors.black[500], opacity: 1 }}
  imageStyle={{ opacity: 0.16 }}
>...

feedback.explanation: Multiple elements in the Card and Transaction list require absolute positioning based on Figma structural data. Grouped by parent container.
Pagination dots (Frame 2095586316) are missing below the card carousel.
feedback.fixedCode:
<View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'center', marginTop: spacing.md }}>
  {[0,1,2].map(i => <View key={i} style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: radius.pill, backgroundColor: i===0 ? colors.white : colors.neutral[600], marginHorizontal: 4 }} />)}
</View>
